engine_binary_baseline: WAL durability + fold scheduling on the 2.5.9 baseline. No index-format migration (v6 generations unchanged; wal/ directory is additive and ignored by older builds). New service CLI switches: --fold-size-mb/--fold-interval-min/--fold-dirty-entries; --save-interval-secs is now the WAL heartbeat cadence (default 30->5). Official GitHub Release artifacts are produced by the existing release.yml CI rebuild on tag v2.5.10 (Windows native only); they are not byte-identical to the local accepted setup.
limitations: installer live handoff not re-run for 2.5.10 (manual service swaps only); payload manifest updated per swap
resident memory unchanged (~108B/entry, 1.5GB at 9.9M): overlay sparsification and FRN compaction evaluated and rejected with measurements (see CHANGELOG)
macOS and Linux native GUI packages do not exist yet
Official CI packages are a new rebuild and are not byte-identical to the local accepted setup
